name: Qwen3.8-27B

architecture.layer_mix: 48 linear (Gated DeltaNet) + 16 full attention, every 4th layer full

context.extension: YaRN, factor = round(len/262144); 2.0 and 4.0 are the card's validated points

summary: Dense all-rounder. Every parameter is awake for every token, so it is 5-8x slower than an equal-quality MoE on bandwidth-limited boxes, but it is the safe default: it fits with room to spare and nothing about it depends on a builder's trick.
known_regressions: Trivia recall got worse vs 3.6 at default settings.
Long analytical documents got worse vs 3.6 at default settings.
Both are a deliberate agentic trade. The vendor's headline table (OSWorld 84.3, SWE-Pro 61.7) is all agentic and visual work; it says nothing about spreadsheets or long-form analysis.
sampler_guidance: Thinking mode wants temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, presence_penalty=0.0. Instruct/non-thinking wants temperature=0.7, top_p=0.8, top_k=20, presence_penalty=1.5. For agent work, community reports greedy (temperature 0) ties the thinking sampler on tool-calling at about 2.5x lower latency, and survived a fake-system-message injection the thinking setup fell for. Pull the reasoning_effort lever instead of temperature.
